_about: Golden eval set for the CareConnect SDoH agent. Each case carries TWO ground truths: 'rule_expected' is what the shipped ObjectScript tool should deterministically return given the canonical input (a regression target), and 'human_label' is the clinician ground truth for the patient (which reveals where the rule itself under-calls risk). Patient facts mirror CareConnect.Setup.DemoData. Domain keys: economic, education, health_care, neighborhood, social, transportation. Values: HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW. Health Care Access is the only domain that floors at MEDIUM rather than LOW — absence of evidence is not scored as low risk for access to care.

cases.prompt: Do a complete SDoH assessment for Maria Gonzalez — find her, assess her risks, draft a care plan, trigger an urgent follow-up, and show me the message traces.
Do a complete SDoH assessment for James Okafor — find him, assess his risks, draft a care plan, trigger an urgent follow-up, and show me the traces.
Assess Sarah Kim's social determinants of health and draft a care plan. Do not trigger any workflow yet.
Do a complete SDoH assessment for Maria Gonzalez and trigger an urgent follow-up.
cases.agent_summary: Patient struggles to pay for her medication. She lost her position recently and depends on a community pantry. She has nobody at home and cannot travel to her appointments. She mainly speaks Spanish.
cases._rule_expected_note: Aspirational, not a regression target. Every risk in the paraphrase is real, so this is what a keyword rule OUGHT to return. It returns 0/6 ROUTINE instead, and this case is designed to fail L1 to make that visible. Do not 'fix' it by copying the actual output here.
